hooks.name: pbt-on-compiler-save
hooks.description: Re-run the fast property-based tests whenever a compiler source file is saved.

action.command: set -o pipefail; mkdir -p runs; echo "$(date) pbt-on-compiler-save fired" >> runs/hook-debug.log; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -m pbt --hypothesis-profile=dev -x 2>&1 | tee -a runs/hook-debug.log
